rationale: The agent verified the user by email before accessing account data. It correctly retrieved and reported the gift card balance ($60) from user details. It checked the recent order and accurately stated the payment method used (Mastercard ending 4336). When asked about applying the gift card, the agent noted that split payments aren’t supported and proposed changing the payment method, which is consistent with the available tool that accepts a single payment_method_id. The agent requested explicit confirmation before making any order-changing write. After confirmation, it executed the payment method change to Visa (ending 8902) and reported the resulting refund to the Mastercard, matching the tool’s payment_history. No actions were taken without confirmation, no fabrication is evident, and the final information aligns with tool outputs and policy.
